titleEn: Blow on Hot Food, Breathe Out Anger!

pages.text: "Six! Seven!" Bung stacked shells on the floor. Little Ddori, not yet talking but good at clapping, clapped beside Bung. The tower reached Bung's knees.
"I will stack ten. Watch, Ddori!" Bung carefully set the eighth on top. A customer boat approached.
It passed, rocking their boat. Shells tumbled! Bung stood and shouted at it. "Go away! You knocked it all down!"
Ddori stepped back, startled. The ankle bell jingled. Bung's face burned, feet stomping. Mom looked up from the stove.
Mom set steaming noodles before Bung. "Hot. Blow before eating." Bung pursed the mouth and blew. White steam drifted away.
Mom laid a hand on Bung's chest. "Hot here too? Blow to cool hot things. Blow on hot food, breathe out anger!" Bung breathed in through the nose, out through the mouth.
Burning cheeks cooled. Bung drew Ddori's hand close and touched the bell. "Scared you? No more shouting."
Ddori picked up a shell and set it on Bung's palm. "Ah!" A pat on the floor. Together, they stacked again.
Another customer boat! The tower shook; anger heated up. "One, hand on chest! Two, breathe in through the nose! Three, out through the mouth! All right. If it falls, we build again."
Mom hugged Bung in both arms. "Breathe out, and anger goes." "Mom, the noodles are cool now too! Blow on hot food, breathe out anger!" Bung slurped.
